# Source: Christmas—Gathering Evergreens and The Christmas-Tree

This GameCore theme is derived from a **specific, real, public-domain work**—not a generated palette.

## Work

- **Title:** Christmas—Gathering Evergreens and The Christmas-Tree
- **Artist / culture:** Winslow Homer (American, 1836-1910) published by Harper's Weekly (American, 1857-1916)
- **Date:** published December 25, 1858
- **Style:** Unspecified
- **Classification:** wood engraving
- **Department:** Prints and Drawings
- **AIC artwork ID:** 158356
- **Artwork page:** https://www.artic.edu/artworks/158356
- **Public-domain image:** https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/343d05cb-f1a1-b2d7-5bab-47b40629715c/full/400,/0/default.jpg
- **Research category:** Christmas

## Extracted source palette

`#D8D8C8, #B8A898, #988878, #686858, #C8C8A8, #E8E8E8, #484838, #787878`

The image was downsampled deterministically and quantized to a four-bit-per-channel histogram.
Colors were ranked by pixel population and de-duplicated by RGB distance. No random values are used.

## Semantic adaptation

- `background`: `#36362E`
- `surface`: `#4D4D46`
- `on_surface`: `#F8F8F6`
- `primary`: `#D8D8C8`
- `on_primary`: `#0C0C0E`
- `secondary`: `#484838`
- `surface_variant`: `#4D4D46`
- `on_surface_variant`: `#F8F8F6`
- `outline`: `#6C6C66`
- `error`: `#D8D8C8`
- `on_error`: `#0C0C0E`

- Font: `serif` (chosen from source style/classification)
- Corner radius: `6dp` (chosen from source object/design classification)
- Body contrast: background `11.46:1`, surface `8.01:1`
- Variant contrast: `8.01:1`
- Control contrast: `13.56:1`

Backgrounds retain a source hue but are toned toward neutral only when needed to ensure body text is
at least 7.0:1. The primary action remains an extracted source color and its ink is chosen
for at least 4.5:1.
